stem:
The diagram shows Vivaan shining a torch at three sheets M, N and O. Through M almost all the light passes and shapes look clear. Through N only some light passes and shapes look unclear. Through O no light passes.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: N is translucent because only some light passes and shapes look unclear.
N is transparent because some light passes through it.
N is opaque because shapes look unclear.
M is translucent because almost all the light passes through it.

teacher.key_rationale: Partial light with unclear shapes means translucent. Calling that transparent or opaque, or calling full clear passage translucent, misclassifies the sheets.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source into three sheets M/N/O with clear, partial, and blocked light paths.
